mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id, a.product_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.auction_time, a.started_at, a.ended_at, a.status, a.bid_count, a.bidder_count, a.view_count, a.bookmark_count, a.top_bid_id, a.extension_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at, a.live_broadcast_id FROM auction a ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.auction_id, a.product_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.auction_time, a.started_at, a.ended_at, a.status, a.bid_count, a.bidder_count, a.view_count, a.bookmark_count, a.top_bid_id, a.extension_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at, a.live_broadcast_id FROM auction a WHERE a.auction_id = #{auctionId}

SELECT a.auction_id, a.product_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.auction_time, a.started_at, a.ended_at, a.status, a.bid_count, a.bidder_count, a.view_count, a.bookmark_count, a.top_bid_id, a.extension_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at, a.live_broadcast_id FROM auction a JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE p.member_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.auction_id, a.product_id, a.start_price, a.current_price, a.auction_time, a.started_at, a.ended_at, a.status, a.bid_count, a.bidder_count, a.view_count, a.bookmark_count, a.top_bid_id, a.extension_count, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at, a.live_broadcast_id FROM auction a WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
